## About

The YAML header sets the viewer's colors without CSS, giving a deep blue
backdrop, a cream caption band, dark brown caption text, and rust links.
Every image on the page gets them.

```yaml
panzoom:
  backdrop: "rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)"
  caption-background: "#f4e9d8"
  caption-color: "#3b2a1a"
  link-color: "#a0361b"
```

Each option sets one of the viewer's CSS variables; [css-class and
CSS](n-css-class.html) sets the same variables from a stylesheet, for some
pages only. A single image or code cell can set its own colors, as cases 2
and 4 show; they apply while that image is open.

## 1. Marked image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

A marked image with a link in its caption. It opens in panzoom with the
colors set on this page, a deep blue backdrop and a cream caption band with
a rust link.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![A marked image, with a [link](https://quarto.org) in its caption.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom}
```

## 2. Colors for one image {#c2 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(232, 243, 234)"}

A marked image with colors of its own, written as attributes on the image.
It opens in panzoom with a deep green backdrop and a pale green caption
band, instead of the colors set on this page.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![A marked image with its own colors, and a [link](https://quarto.org) in its caption.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom backdrop="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" caption-background="#e8f3ea" caption-color="#173d24" link-color="#0b6b3a"}
```

## 3. Code cell {#c3 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

A marked R cell. It opens in panzoom with the colors set on this page, as
case 1 does.

```{r}
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-cap: "A code cell's plot, on the same blue and cream viewer."

plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19)
```

## 4. Colors for one cell {#c4 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(251, 233, 220)"}

A marked R cell with colors of its own, under `#| panzoom:`. It opens in
panzoom with a dark red backdrop and a peach caption band.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   backdrop: "rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)"
#|   caption-background: "#fbe9dc"
#|   caption-color: "#4a1f10"
#| fig-cap: "A code cell's plot, with colors of its own."

plot(cars, pch = 19)
```
